rules_text.raw: The target changes to one creature touched per level. Affected creatures gain cold resistance 5 and fire resistance 5. They’re not slowed by snow, and ignore penalties on Perception checks and ranged weapon attacks from hail, rain, sleet, and snow. They treat wind as one category weaker.
